statement: Each listed SVG is an authored diagram with declared source truth and is validated for parseability and accessibility; SVG entries are not claimed to carry per-file hashes or dimensions here. Each listed PNG is either a declared fixed-clock capture of the shipped UI using only the repository's fictional demo board, or artwork supplied by the maintainer; its recorded hash and dimensions verify the checked-in bytes. No customer data, person images, or private product state is embedded. The owner marks depict the agent runtimes and hardware a row is running on; the maintainer states these are their own work, and publication rights below cover them.
publication_rights: maintainer-authorized for public release under the MIT License; no independent external rights verification is claimed
